fact: UNDP Burundi says DSNIS uses DHIS2 as the sole system for collecting and transmitting health data in real time, validated at district, province and DSNIS level, and tuberculosis data checks ran in 16 provinces on 3-22 June 2024.

Burundi's health ministry guide states that the data produced by all health facilities are entered in DHIS2 and are accessible to districts, provinces and the central level, with the national health information directorate (DSNIS) administering DHIS2.

The Burundi health ministry's Annuaire 2024 states that monthly reports from health facilities and community groups are entered in DHIS2, validated by district and province offices, and compiled by the DSNIS into a national database.
The Annuaire 2024 publishes a national average completeness of 99.6 percent for community (GASC) monthly reports entered in DHIS2 in 2024, with a district-by-district table.
OpenFn states DHIS2 is used for aggregate national health reporting and programme monitoring in Burundi.
OpenFn states a scheduled workflow aggregates HIV indicators from SIDAInfo, the HIV electronic medical record, and pushes them to DHIS2.
